clips.title: The story
paras: Kul Tiras forces keep their coastal positions in Durotar, and Admiral Proudmoore's Orders lay out their plans. The documents were written before Daelin Proudmoore fell at Theramore and describe a campaign against the Horde.

Admiral Proudmoore's Orders show that the Kul Tiras forces at Tiragarde Keep still mean to fight. Lieutenant Benedict's garrison holds the papers, which detail long-term maneuvers and fortifications against the Horde. The plans show that Daelin Proudmoore's offensive in Durotar was an organized campaign, built to continue after his death. For the Horde, the documents reveal Kul Tiras operations and possible reinforcements threatening its borders.
